_about: Correct values for scripts/selftest.py. Each group names its source: hand check, CEDA rule agreed with the designer, CEDA Excel calc / issued drawing (VOCO Bangkok Sukhumvit 11), or engine baseline (regression lock, re-baseline only when a rule change is agreed). Units: kg, cm, kg-m in the engine; values below as stated.

T1_layout._source: CEDA rules (grid c/c 125-150, small-face count, symmetric ties, tie-corner bundle ladder) – C1 2000x450 hand-drawn with the designer (Oct 2026) | ladder order CEDA 20 Oct 2026: each bundle size completed over the whole section (tie corners first) before the next size

T5_small_face._source: CEDA rule 19 Oct 2026: face <= 200 mm 2 bars, <= 540 3, <= 660 4, else c/c 125-150; ACI 25.2.3 clear spacing; ACI 25.7.2.3 tie support

T2_C1_VOCO._source: engine v1.2 design of VOCO C1 from the issued Excel load sheets (03_01_01..06), Lu/k as confirmed by the designer (basement 2.75 m k 1.0; above ground 4.5 m k 0.9), βd 0.888 | B6-B5 62 -> 64-DB32 with the CEDA ladder order of 20 Oct 2026 (2-bar bundles completed before 3-bar)

T8_C1_issued_drawing._source: issued drawing S-04-01-01 R3 (VOCO), mark C1, bars on the drawn 22-position grid (10 bars on the 2000 face, 3 on the 450 face); engine 3D-surface D/C with the same loads. Issued design must check D/C <= 1 where the Lu/k match the issued calc. | 4th-10th 44-DB28 = 2-bar bundles at all 22 positions (CEDA ladder order 20 Oct 2026, as drawn) -> D/C 0.880

T3_etabs_basement._source: hand check on the synthetic 4-story ETABS set (tests/fixtures/make_synthetic_etabs.py): CEDA Rev.1 basement load assembly

T4_story_ranges._source: CEDA rule: basement every story; above ground 2-3 stories with 12 m + Lst; f'c change always a break; early break on bundle removal / half steel

T6_marks._source: CEDA marking rules 19 Oct 2026 (same label = same mark; same section incl. 90° rotation; ties in the mark; critical ties) + criterion A 20 Oct 2026: per label <= 25 % extra longitudinal steel, project <= 10 %, no row / step limit

T7_excel_input._source: VOCO test export (forces only, tests/fixtures/voco_column_load.xlsx) + CEDA input workbook (tests/fixtures/voco_input_workbook.xlsx): Criteria, Stories (4.5 m), Sections (450x2000 for the test), Combos copied from the ETABS combo sheet

T9_wide_grid._source: CEDA decision 20 Oct 2026 (Jan): singles / 2-bar bundles c/c 125-150, 3-4-bar bundles c/c up to 160 mm. Hand check ACI 25.2.3 + 25.6.1.6, DB32: deq3 = 55.4 -> clear 83.1 mm, deq4 = 64 -> 96.0 mm; 900x900 (e = 68 mm, span 764): 7 bars c/c 127.3 -> 3-bundle beside a 2-bundle clear 127.3-48 = 79.3 < 83.1 (blocked); 6 bars c/c 152.8 -> 3-3 clear 88.8 OK, 4-bundle at a corner beside <=2 bars 152.8-48 = 104.8 >= 96 OK. BKMPH02 run 20 Oct 2026. | v1.3.3 ladder order (2-bar everywhere, then 3-bar): first wide step 44-DB32 (3-bar at tie corners), max 60-DB32 (3-bar everywhere; 4-bar beside 3-bar needs c/c 160 > 152.8)

T10_inner_bars._source: CEDA pattern BKMPH02\Output\paattern.dxf (20 Oct 2026, Jan): DB32, cover 40 + tie DB12 (bar centre 68 mm). 1100×900: inner hoops x 1992–2311 / 2405–2724, y 3764–4062 (origin 1808, 3463) -> inner bars at x 205.7/481.1/618.9/894.3, y 322.7/577.3 mm; 900×900: x, y 322.7/577.3. Rules: last resort after the perimeter (125-150 grid, then wider grid 3-4 bundles); basement (compression) or label-stories approved for ρ > 6 % only.

T14_input_layer.source: BKMPH02 'Development of Reinforcement Table.xlsx' sheet 40mm (CEDA TABLE 11.04, Lst = Class B other bar), checked against the Lap sheet of BKMPH02_Column_Input_final.xlsx (21 Oct 2026); combo file '04 Load Combination.xlsx'

T15_fc_study.source: Hand-built matrix for the CEDA f'c rule of 23 Oct 2026 (outliers ≤ 10 % / ≤ 25 %, D/C ≥ 0.75 with the typical-f'c minimum-steel exemption, ≥ 50 % at ρ ≤ 1.5 % at the reduction story). 400 ksc everywhere: 30 column-stories × 0.5×0.5×3.0 m = 22.5 m³ × 2,600 = 58,500; As 20 cm² × 300 cm × 7.85e-3 = 47.1 kg × 30 = 1,413 kg × 23.5 = 33,205.5 → 91,706 THB (rounded)
